title: Signal Denoising
description: Build a reproducible noisy signal, compare smoothing filters, and connect time-domain and frequency-domain evidence.

zh-Hant.title: 訊號去雜訊
zh-Hant.description: 建立可重現的含雜訊訊號、比較平滑濾波器，並串連時域與頻域證據。

artifacts.label: Signal Components
artifacts.alt: Stacked time-series plots showing the clean signal, added noise, and resulting noisy observation
artifacts.caption: Separating the clean waveform and noise makes the denoising objective explicit before any filter is applied.

zh-Hant.label: 訊號組成
zh-Hant.alt: 依序顯示乾淨訊號、加入的雜訊與最終含雜訊觀測值的時序圖
zh-Hant.caption: 先拆解乾淨波形與雜訊，可在套用濾波器之前清楚界定去雜訊目標。

artifacts.label: Denoising Comparison
artifacts.alt: Time-series chart comparing the noisy signal, filtered signal, and clean reference signal
artifacts.caption: The filtered trace should suppress rapid noise while preserving the shape and timing of the clean waveform.

zh-Hant.label: 去雜訊結果比較
zh-Hant.alt: 比較含雜訊訊號、濾波後訊號與乾淨參考訊號的時序圖
zh-Hant.caption: 濾波後曲線應抑制快速雜訊，同時保留乾淨波形的形狀與時間位置。

artifacts.label: Frequency Spectrum
artifacts.alt: Frequency-domain spectrum comparing clean, noisy, and filtered signals
artifacts.caption: The spectrum reveals whether filtering reduces high-frequency noise without removing the dominant signal frequencies.

zh-Hant.label: 頻率頻譜
zh-Hant.alt: 比較乾淨、含雜訊與濾波後訊號的頻域頻譜
zh-Hant.caption: 頻譜可檢查濾波是否降低高頻雜訊，同時保留主要訊號頻率。

artifacts.label: Filter Window Trade-off
artifacts.alt: Chart showing output signal quality and error across several smoothing-window sizes
artifacts.caption: Short windows retain detail but remove less noise, while long windows smooth aggressively and may distort the waveform.

zh-Hant.label: 濾波視窗取捨
zh-Hant.alt: 顯示不同平滑視窗大小之輸出訊號品質與誤差的圖表
zh-Hant.caption: 短視窗保留較多細節但去除較少雜訊；長視窗平滑較強，卻可能扭曲波形。

sections.title: Code Case Overview
sections.summary: Frame denoising as a measurable recovery problem and inspect the latest quality indicators.

zh-Hant.title: 程式碼案例概覽
zh-Hant.summary: 將去雜訊視為可量化的訊號還原問題，並檢視最新品質指標。

blocks.title: Recover structure without erasing information
paragraphs: This code case starts with a known clean waveform, adds controlled random noise, and then evaluates how well a moving-average filter reconstructs the reference.
Because the clean signal is retained in this reference case, SNR and RMSE provide direct and interpretable evidence of filter quality.

zh-Hant.title: 還原結構而不抹除資訊
paragraphs: 此程式碼案例從已知的乾淨波形開始，加入受控的隨機雜訊，再評估移動平均濾波器重建參考訊號的成效。
由於此參考案例保留乾淨訊號，SNR 與 RMSE 能直接且清楚地呈現濾波品質。

items.label: Raw RMSE
items.detail: Noisy signal error against the clean reference

zh-Hant.label: 原始 RMSE
zh-Hant.detail: 含雜訊訊號相對乾淨參考值的誤差

items.label: Filtered RMSE
items.detail: Filtered signal error against the clean reference

zh-Hant.label: 濾波後 RMSE
zh-Hant.detail: 濾波後訊號相對乾淨參考值的誤差

items.label: Best window
items.detail: Window size with the lowest published RMSE

zh-Hant.label: 最佳視窗
zh-Hant.detail: 已發布結果中 RMSE 最低的視窗大小

blocks.title: A reference signal enables objective evaluation
blocks.content: Real measurements rarely include a perfectly clean target. Here it is retained so every filtering decision can be evaluated objectively.

zh-Hant.title: 參考訊號可支援客觀評估
zh-Hant.content: 真實量測通常沒有完全乾淨的目標；本範例保留參考訊號，讓每個濾波決策都能客觀評估。

sections.title: Construct the Signal
sections.summary: Combine interpretable components with deterministic noise to create a reproducible experiment.

zh-Hant.title: 建構訊號
zh-Hant.summary: 結合可解釋的訊號成分與固定雜訊，建立可重現的實驗。

blocks.title: Generate the clean and noisy signals

zh-Hant.title: 生成乾淨與含雜訊訊號

items.title: Create the time base
items.content: Use evenly spaced samples so frequency and filter behavior are easy to interpret.

zh-Hant.title: 建立時間軸
zh-Hant.content: 使用等間距取樣，讓頻率與濾波器行為容易解讀。

items.title: Compose the clean waveform
items.content: Combine low-frequency components that represent the information to preserve.

zh-Hant.title: 組合乾淨波形
zh-Hant.content: 結合代表待保留資訊的低頻成分。

items.title: Add reproducible noise
items.content: Fix the random seed before adding noise so filter comparisons remain fair across runs.

zh-Hant.title: 加入可重現雜訊
zh-Hant.content: 加入雜訊前固定隨機種子，確保不同執行之間的濾波比較公平。

sections.title: Compare Filtered Signals
sections.summary: Inspect how smoothing changes the waveform and calculate objective recovery metrics.

zh-Hant.title: 比較濾波訊號
zh-Hant.summary: 觀察平滑處理如何改變波形，並計算客觀的還原品質指標。

blocks.title: Read SNR and RMSE together
blocks.content: Higher output SNR and lower filtered RMSE both indicate improvement, but the plotted waveform is still needed to detect oversmoothing and timing distortion.

zh-Hant.title: 同時解讀 SNR 與 RMSE
zh-Hant.content: 較高的輸出 SNR 與較低的濾波後 RMSE 都代表改善，但仍需檢視波形，才能發現過度平滑與時間失真。

sections.title: Inspect the Frequency Spectrum
sections.summary: Use frequency-domain evidence to distinguish useful components from broadband noise.

zh-Hant.title: 檢視頻率頻譜
zh-Hant.summary: 運用頻域證據區分有用訊號成分與寬頻雜訊。

blocks.title: What a useful filter should preserve
blocks.content: Dominant peaks associated with the clean waveform should remain visible while energy spread across higher frequencies is reduced.

zh-Hant.title: 有效濾波器應保留什麼
zh-Hant.content: 與乾淨波形相關的主要頻率峰值應保持可見，而分散於較高頻率的能量應被降低。

sections.title: Choose the Smoothing Window
sections.summary: Compare candidate windows and explain why the minimum-error choice is not automatically perfect.

zh-Hant.title: 選擇平滑視窗
zh-Hant.summary: 比較候選視窗，並說明最低誤差的選擇為何不一定完美。

blocks.title: Window benchmark
blocks.description: The highlighted row has the lowest filtered RMSE among the published candidates.

zh-Hant.title: 視窗效能比較
zh-Hant.description: 醒目標示的列是在已發布候選視窗中，濾波後 RMSE 最低的結果。

blocks.title: Do not optimize one number blindly
blocks.content: A window can minimize average error while weakening short-lived features. Confirm the numerical choice against both plots and the intended application.

zh-Hant.title: 不要盲目最佳化單一數字
zh-Hant.content: 某個視窗可能降低平均誤差，卻削弱短暫特徵；應同時依據圖表與實際用途確認數值選擇。

sections.title: Trace the Source Code
sections.summary: Connect the publishing entry point with data generation, evaluation, and plot export functions.

zh-Hant.title: 追蹤原始程式碼
zh-Hant.summary: 串連發布入口、資料生成、濾波評估與圖表匯出函式。

blocks.title: One orchestration function, three focused helpers
paragraphs: The main function coordinates the run and publishes the resulting JSON, MATLAB files, and plots.
Separating signal generation, filter evaluation, and visualization keeps each processing responsibility easy to inspect and reuse.

zh-Hant.title: 一個協調入口與三個專注輔助函式
paragraphs: 主函式負責協調整次執行，並發布產生的 JSON、MATLAB 檔案與圖表。
將訊號生成、濾波評估與視覺化分開，可讓每項處理職責更容易檢視與重用。
